svg.title: Cut The Crap — Book store
svg.desc: Sales hub for the Cut The Crap book with a library, Founder's Edition, store, cart, checkout and customer portal. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Motion, Express. Live at cat-the-carp.vercel.app. Last updated Sep 9, 2026.
